segments.name: e-commerce services
segments.description: Operates e-commerce platforms, providing online marketing services and transaction services to merchants and consumers using its platforms.
segments.evidence: The Group operates and manages its business as a single segment and has one operating and reportable segment, the provision of e-commerce services.

revenueModel.text: Merchant-customers pay for online marketing services and transaction services on the company's e-commerce platforms, which connect them with consumers.
revenueModel.evidence: Our merchant-customers are attracted to our platforms by the plentiful sales opportunities on our platforms and the value of the transaction services we provide.
